name: Homekeeping
source:
Rutile finally lands her dream job… as a maid! But with such an unusual mistress to serve, will her work be as smooth as she imagined?

[From [url=https://spicaze.itch.io/homekeeping]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
露緹爾終於找到了夢想中的工作……當女僕！可要侍奉這樣一位不同尋常的女主人，這份差事真會像她想的那麼順利嗎？
